utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — that helps a lot. I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’m glad you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad to help. Just send me the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. That should be enough for the porch repairs on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Okay, I’ve got it — a screwdriver set and a small hammer for Saturday on the porch. I’ll do my best not to forget!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive this Sunday at the community center, and I can check with a neighbor or two as well.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Rosa — that’d be a huge help. If they can, tell them to come by the community center this Sunday and I’ll put them to work!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. Could you ask around for one more helper and let me know by Friday so I can keep the setup straight?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll ask around for one more helper and get back to you by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Could you help on the front porch this Saturday, or bring a basic tool kit if that’s easier?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I can help on Sunday at the community center, and I can bring a basic tool kit too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam, that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone else handy, send them my way and I’ll keep you posted on the porch setup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I will. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I find anyone handy for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik. I’m still trying to pin down the helper list for Saturday on the front porch, so even one more person would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That helps a lot, Pia. I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’ll keep spreading the word for a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning works for me. Just send the exact time and I’ll bring my gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, Saturday morning it is. I’ll send you the exact time and I’ll bring a few basic tools too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
